steps.vo: Buying NEAR with Paya takes four simple steps.

steps.caption: Enter an amount in your currency
steps.vo: Enter how much you want to spend, in your own currency.

steps.caption: See exactly what you get
steps.vo: See exactly how much NEAR you'll get, before you pay.

steps.caption: Send a normal bank transfer
steps.vo: Then send a normal bank transfer.

steps.caption: NEAR lands in your balance
steps.vo: And your NEAR lands in your Paya balance.
Cashing out NEAR to your bank is just as simple.

steps.caption: Choose an amount, or tap Max
steps.vo: Choose an amount, or tap Max.

steps.caption: See the cash you'll receive
steps.vo: See exactly how much cash you'll receive, and every fee.

steps.caption: Paid straight to your bank
steps.vo: Paya pays it straight to your linked bank account.

steps.caption: Or cash out automatically
steps.vo: Or turn on auto cash-out, and every payment lands in your bank.
Swap any token on NEAR, right inside Paya.

steps.caption: Pick what you have and what you want
steps.vo: Pick what you have, and what you want. Like NEAR to USDC.

steps.caption: See the rate and the minimum
steps.vo: See the rate, and the minimum you'll get.

steps.caption: Done in seconds
steps.vo: Tap swap. NEAR Intents finds the price, and it lands in seconds.

steps.caption: Or connect your own wallet
steps.vo: Prefer your own wallet? Connect it, and swap from there.

steps.caption: Send USDC to a Solana wallet
steps.vo: Send USDC to a Solana wallet, in one step.

steps.caption: Receive with a one-time address
steps.vo: Or receive from Ethereum. Paya gives you a one-time deposit address.

steps.caption: Solana, Ethereum, Base, Bitcoin and more
steps.vo: Solana, Ethereum, Base, Bitcoin, and more.

steps.caption: Ready to swap, send or cash out

outro: Paya. Buy, sell, swap and bridge. At use paya dot x y z.

steps.vo: Meet Ask Paya. Just tell it what you want to do with your money.

steps.caption: Ask in plain words
steps.vo: Ask in plain words. Like, swap half my NEAR to USDC.

steps.caption: It checks your balance and the price
steps.vo: It checks your real balance and the live price, then prepares the swap.
